description: Benign innocent greeting with hidden malicious phishing URL
text: Hey buddy! Check out the vacation photos from our weekend trip right here:
notes: Text model alone predicts benign, but lexical URL model detects phishing, triggering multimodal safety escalation.

description: Urgent Bank of America alert pointing to unrelated legitimate Google domain (Brand Discrepancy)
text: BANK OF AMERICA: Urgent! Your checking account has been compromised. Verify immediately:
notes: Contradiction engine flags severe brand mismatch: Text claims Bank of America but URL points to google.com.

description: Smishing urgency text with legitimate brand URL to evade simple domain filters
text: URGENT SECURITY ALERT: Unauthorized transfer of $2,450 detected. Call 1-800-FAKE immediately or visit your portal at https://paypal.com
notes: Text contains heavy smishing/urgency triggers despite legitimate domain in URL; text classifier and urgency detector flag the threat.

description: Subdomain brand spoofing with high-risk TLD
text: Netflix billing: Your membership has been paused. Restore access here: https://netflix.com.verify-billing-center.xyz/reactivate
notes: Brand 'netflix' is in the subdomain while root domain is verify-billing-center.xyz with suspicious TLD .xyz.

description: Shortened/redirect masking with IP literal link in conversational text
